title: The CI paragraph of CLAUDE.md, with complaints and peeves

source.text: [`.github/workflows/test.yml`](.github/workflows/test.yml) runs `npm test` on every pull request and reports it as a check on the PR, so the test speaks even when no session runs the suite. `page-measures.yml` also runs on pull requests that touch a page and gives advisory output only, so a red result is not expected or intended. The suite is browser-free by construction (`node --test` globs `node/test/**/*.test.mjs`, and every Playwright-driven check is named without `.test.`), so keep it that way or the runner grows a browser install. `package-lock.json` is gitignored, so CI resolves dependency ranges fresh on each run and a green check is not a claim about a pinned tree.
